package.description: A multi-platform web browser for RISC OS, UNIX-like platforms (including Linux), Mac OS X, and more.

en-US.description: A multi-platform web browser for RISC OS, UNIX-like platforms (including Linux), Mac OS X, and more.
en-US.longDescription: NetSurf is a free, open source web browser. It is written in C and released under the GNU Public Licence version 2. NetSurf has its own layout and rendering engine entirely written from scratch. It is small and capable of handling many of the web standards in use today.
en-US.name: NetSurf

zh-CN.description: 多平台网络浏览器，适用于 RISC OS、类 UNIX 平台（包括 Linux）、Mac OS X 等。
zh-CN.longDescription: NetSurf 是一款免费开源的网络浏览器。它由 C 语言编写，根据 GNU 公共许可证第 2 版发布。NetSurf 拥有自己的布局和渲染引擎，完全从零开始编写。它体积小，能够处理当今使用的许多网络标准。
